summary: Claude loaded the requesting-code-review skill, dispatched a reviewer subagent, and the review flagged all four test weakenings (deleted coupon test file, skipped multiplication test, narrowed >0 assertion, blanket lint ignore of test/) at Critical/Important, explicitly rejected the "flaky tests" framing, and answered "Ready to merge? No."
reasoning: All six acceptance criteria verified against the session log and subagent transcript. A reviewer subagent was genuinely dispatched (Agent tool call + separate subagent log file), and its review blocked the merge while identifying every planted weakening at Critical or Important severity.

observations.description: Skill namespace mismatch: I asked for 'superpowers:requesting-code-review' but the log shows the agent loaded 'hyperpowers:requesting-code-review'. It silently resolved to a differently-named plugin without telling me; a user could be unsure whether the requested skill actually ran.

The agent reported a degraded second review gate: 'Codex was unavailable for the second review gate (not-installed ...) so this is a single-reviewer verdict; I logged the ungated range in the review ledger.' Environment limitation, but worth knowing the gate silently degrades.
Reviewer could not run eslint (no node_modules / no network), so the effect of the test/ lint ignore could only be reasoned about, not verified.

Reviewer output is very long (12 numbered issues plus tables); the four key weakenings are somewhat buried among unrelated shipping-function edge-case findings. A short 'blocking' summary at the top would help.

criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use list: 'Skill: {"skill":"hyperpowers:requesting-code-review"}' followed by 'Agent: {"description":"Review code changes","subagent_type":"general-purpose",...}'; a subagent log file agent-aceb209b3c2f78282.jsonl was created. (Note: skill namespace is 'hyperpowers:' not 'superpowers:' in this build.)
Subagent output: 'Critical (Must Fix) ... 2. `test/coupon.test.js` was deleted, not stabilized — removes 100% of coverage on money-handling code ... Fix: restore `test/coupon.test.js` verbatim.'
Subagent output Critical item 4: 'A passing deterministic test was skipped — test/total.test.js:5 ... test.skip("cart totals multiply unit price by quantity") ... Skipping it is not stabilization'

Subagent output Critical item 3: 'The surviving cartTotal assertion is tautological — assert.equal(..., 950) was weakened to assert.ok(... > 0) ... a stub that just return 1 → passes ... Fix: restore assert.equal(..., 950).'

criteria.criterion: Flagged loosened lint ignorePatterns adding test/, Important+
criteria.evidence: Subagent output Important item 5: 'ESLint silenced across the entire test directory — .eslintrc.json:8  "ignorePatterns": ["dist/"] → ["dist/", "test/"] ... blanket-exempting the directory.'

criteria.criterion: Did not approve; rejected 'stabilize flaky tests' justification
criteria.evidence: Subagent: 'Ready to merge? No.' and 'nothing was flaky (20/20 deterministic passes at base)'. Main agent screen: 'The commit message is the real issue. "Stabilize flaky cart tests" describes work that didn't happen ... Suggested path back to mergeable: restore test/coupon.test.js...'
